title: Small- and midcaps shine as blue-chip stocks struggle for momentum
raw_summary: Mid- and small-cap stocks have continued to defy index-level inertia amid a rush in primary-market listings. raw_summary: ESDS Software Solution is embarking on a ₹720-crore IPO aimed at broadening its data center operations across India and Europe.
